scenarios: not installed: reports nothing, activation and input do nothing, a grant is refused
the first activation dials; the connect re-declares the run, activates and reports the change
a failed connect is dialled again after 1 s, doubling to 30 s; a connect resets the backoff
a deactivation cancels the redial; a close without wanted activation does not dial
a close while activation is wanted clears the frame and is dialled again
input becomes the protocol events; a button without a position goes to the last pointer
a refused send rejects with the client’s error
Ctrl+Alt+Delete becomes sas while the helper holds Ctrl and Alt; any release point clears the record
the client’s events: desktop changes, challenges, issues and frames reach the listeners
the video run is sent while connected; a grant goes to the client
dispose: the redial is cancelled, listeners dropped, the connection closed; a late connect is closed
a connect still running at dispose is closed when it succeeds
